name: komdosh-dev-infra-core
description: The foundation for infrastructure-as-code and GitOps: the shared safety, secrets, promotion, and data-protection discipline the other infra plugins build on. Every action obeys one contract — render the desired state, review the blast radius, apply only the reviewed artifact. Three read-only agents review a change across six dimensions, hunt exposed secrets across every layer, and audit personal data across the infrastructure lifecycle under both 152-FZ and GDPR. Read-only at the tool layer, not merely by convention. No cloud or language assumptions.
